title: DBM, LGU leagues unite to fast-track local projects

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Budget and Management (DBM) and local government leagues agreed on Thursday to strengthen coordination to speed up local development projects and address concerns regarding the 2026 Collective Negotiation Agreement (CNA) Incentive guidelines. According to a joint statement issued on Thursday, the agreement was the result of a meeting between Budget Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon and representatives of the League of Municipalities of the Philippines (LMP), League of Cities of the Philippines (LCP), League of Provinces of the Philippines (LPP), and Union of Local Authorities of the Philippines (ULAP).
